messages:
Olivia (CS): quick weekly ping for Quasar (QSR-54) onboarding — wanted to call out token & throughput signals from this week. QoW token usage +18% (mostly longer completion lengths), QoQ +3%. Throughput nominal but 95p latency spiked Tue 04:10 UTC from ~140ms -> ~420ms. 5xx rate rose to ~0.8% (was 0.15%), concentrated on /v1/generate. Spend +22% WoW due to prompt expansion. attaching short summary + links.

Asha K.: thanks — do we have breakdown by route and model variant? any batching or client-side changes on their side? :mag:

Miguel R.: looked at infra logs — spike aligns w/ canary deploy in eu-west-1 at 04:05 UTC. DeployBot shows a kernel/cuda-rt update rolled out to a subset, rollback at 04:12 brought p95 back down. raw snippet: ```deploy_id=deploy-2026-04-27-2235 region=eu-west-1 action=apply -> rollback at 04:12:33 status=partial-failure```

Olivia (CS): good catch — so likely runtime regression. Can we confirm error types on the 5xx? Is it OOM, timeout, or internal serv errors? Also customer-facing ask: suggest we temporarily pin Quasar to the pre-canary model variant and reduce max_batch to 8 to avoid tail amplification.

Miguel R.: majority = HTTP 502 from serving proxy (gateway timeout) and a handful of 500s from model worker indicating kernel compatibility faults. After rollback, 502s fell to baseline. I'll collect kernel traces and a short flamegraph by EOD.

DeployBot: automated note — rollback recorded for deploy-2026-04-27-2235 (eu-west-1). Owner: eng-runtime.

Priya (AM): I'll message Quasar about the transient incident and suggest prompt trimming + retry/backoff recommendations. Renewal risk: low right now but flagging potential overage in next invoice if usage growth continues. I'll propose a quick usage review call. :phone:

Asha K.: plan of action: 1) Miguel to upload traces + root-cause note (EOD). 2) Olivia to request pin and batch config change for Quasar (immediate). 3) Priya to prep customer comms and schedule a 30m usage review this week. 4) Ops to add a deploy-preflight check for kernel/rt combos. I'll create the Jira and tag eng-runtime.

Olivia (CS): thanks team — assign owners above. I'll update account health dashboard and include the QoW/QoQ token trends for next CS sync. If anyone sees fresh spikes ping here. :thumbsup:
